sources.verified_angle_summary: Saudi Business Machines (SBM) introduced Maxera, a 3D digital twin solution built on IBM Maximo and watsonx, at LEAP 2026. The platform provides a comprehensive, interactive 3D representation of assets, facilities, and operations. It enables real-time monitoring, analysis, and optimization of infrastructure. Additionally, Maxera leverages Generative AI to automatically generate dashboards, insights, and operational views, enhancing decision-making capabilities for enterprise asset management. This specific product launch represents a concrete asset-maintenance development within the IBM partner ecosystem at the event.
